_comment: Discord music bot playing YouTube, SoundCloud and anything else yt-dlp reaches. The startup command must remain a single command: the yolks entrypoint runs it through 'exec env', with no shell to interpret operators or control flow.
name: Discord Music Bot
author: galfi.benedek@gmail.com
description: Discord music bot on Node.js. Plays YouTube and SoundCloud natively through yt-dlp, bridges Spotify links to a YouTube match, and supports both prefixed text commands and slash commands. yt-dlp is fetched as a self contained binary matching the container's libc, so no Python is needed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Pterodactyl installation script for the Discord music bot.
set -e

# The Node.js yolks images already ship git and curl. Only reach for a package
# manager if this egg was pointed at a leaner container, and cope with both the
# Debian and the Alpine based images.
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates
    elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apk add --no-cache git curl
    fi
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
    echo "Cloning ${GIT_REPO}"
    rm -rf /tmp/botsrc
    if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/botsrc
    else
        git clone --depth 1 "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/botsrc
    fi
    rm -rf /tmp/botsrc/.git
    cp -a /tmp/botsrc/. /mnt/server/
    rm -rf /tmp/botsrc
elif [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "No GIT_REPO set, using the files already in the server directory."
else
    echo "Nothing to install."
    echo "Either set the GIT_REPO variable, or upload the bot files (package.json, src/, scripts/) first and reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "package.json is missing after the copy. Check the repository or the uploaded files."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing dependencies"
npm install --no-audit --no-fund

echo "Installation done."

variables.name: Bot token
variables.description: Discord Developer Portal, Bot, Reset Token. Keep it secret.

variables.name: Application ID
variables.description: Developer Portal, General Information, Application ID. Only needed for slash commands.

variables.name: Command prefix
variables.description: Prefix for text commands, for example a dot gives .play

variables.name: Register slash commands
variables.description: Set to 1 to register slash commands on every start. Text commands work without this.

variables.name: Slash command server ID
variables.description: Register slash commands on this one server so they appear instantly. Empty registers globally, which takes up to an hour.

variables.name: Default volume
variables.description: Volume in percent every new player starts at.

variables.name: Maximum volume
variables.description: Ceiling users can set with the volume command. Above 100 amplifies and can distort.

variables.name: Idle timeout
variables.description: Seconds to stay in a voice channel after the queue runs out or everyone leaves. 0 stays forever.

variables.name: Spotify client ID
variables.description: Optional. Only needed to accept Spotify links. Free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard.

variables.name: Spotify client secret
variables.description: Optional. Pairs with the Spotify client ID.

variables.name: yt-dlp cookies file
variables.description: Optional. Path to a Netscape format cookies.txt, for age restricted videos or bot checks.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Optional. Install pulls the bot from here. Leave empty to use files you upload yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Optional. Branch to clone when a repository is set.
